annotations.caption: An illuminated chain link fence separates an area with trees and grass from a weeded area.
A night image of a chain link fence illuminated with a light showing two separated areas with one comprised of trees and the other an urban area with a building.

A clear blue sky is over an area with trees barred off by a chain link fence from an urban area with a building and sidewalk closed sign. There is a blue and orange bar in the ground next to the fence and a metal object nearby.
Weeds surround metal bars and a board next to a chain link fence with a green privacy screen which is falling down in some areas. Behind it, there is a gravel area with a building.

A wooded area comprised of bare trees and green grass is separated by a chain link fence from an urban area where a bike rack next to a path and building are visible. A blue and orange bar is in the ground and nearby it are metal bars.
Weeds surround bars next to a chain link fence covered with a privacy screen which is falling down in some portions. They are in front of a gravel area with a building next to it.
A night image of metal bars and a board in weeds and gravel on the ground next to a chain link fence with a falling privacy screen which barriers a gravel area and an illuminated building.
A green privacy screen is on a chain link fence with portions falling down to the right. Through the fence there is a building under a clear blue sky with trees to the right.

A night image illuminated by a bright light in which a weeded area is in front of a chain link fence covered in a tattered privacy screen through which a building is visible. A path sits on the left by other foliage.
A night image of a chain link fence with a privacy screen which is falling down on one side. Through the fence there is a building and trees are illuminated by a light.
A green privacy screen with intermittent tears over a chain link fence separates a dirt area by a path with bare bushes and a building from a building visible through the fence.
A green privacy screen with intermittent tears over a chain link fence separates a dirt area by a path with green bushes and wildflowers and a building from a building visible through the fence.
Weeds in front of a chain link fence with a green privacy screen with tears in front of a gravel area by a building. Next to it stands another building by a path with shrubs nearby.

A night image illuminated by a bright light in which a weeded area is in front of a chain link fence covered in a tattered privacy screen through which a building is visible. A path sits on the left by other foliage.

A dark, urban scene over the intersection of Clinton and Roosevelt at whose corner sits an illuminated parking lot and businesses. In the distance, cars are visible behind which the sky line of tall buildings can be seen.

A dark urban scene in which cars drive through the intersection of Clinton and Roosevelt past buildings and their illuminated parking lots. Buildings with lights are visible in the background in the night sky.
To the left is a bike share next to a road with cars driving in both directions. On the other side, cars are parked by the sidewalk in front of a line of businesses.

A dark, urban scene of a black sky over the intersection of Clinton and Roosevelt at whose corner sits a building whose light illuminates a parking lot. pedestrians walk on the sidewalk lined with snow. The skyline has tall buildings visible.

A dark, urban scene at the intersection of Clinton and Roosevelt through which cars drive at night. At the snowy corner, a building's light illuminates parking lots nearby. In the background, the skyline is comprised of tall buildings with lights on under a black sky.
To the left is a bike share by a line of parked cars on a city street with heavy traffic. On the other side, more cars are parked by a line of businesses.

To the left, a bike share is next to a rod on which two cars drive in opposing directions. The other side of the road has businesses lined up along the sidewalk illuminated by streetlamps and their signs in the night.

An urban, night scene in covered by a dark, blue sky in which cars drive over a wet road illuminated by headlights and street lamps. On the other side is an orange sign by an illuminated building which is near another lot and business with cars parked there.

A dark, blue, grey cloudy sky covers the intersection of Clinton and Roosevelt at which cars wait at one side and drive by a line of buildings on the other. Cars can be seen parked nearby a grey building under an illuminated billboard. In the background, the skyline is visible as a series of buildings with lights on and an antenna.

Heavy traffic waits at an intersection along with a biker. Pedestrians can be seen on the sidewalk and waiting at the intersection. The sun shines on a parking log with buildings visible in the background.

Heavy traffic waits at an intersection with snow on the ground nearby. On the other side, an orange sign is on the sidewalk near businesses and parking lots with cars. In the background, the skyline with tall buildings is seen under a cloudy sky.

An overcast sky covers the intersection of Clinton and Roosevelt at which cars wait by a large billboard over a grey building. Other cars are seen driving nearby as is a pedestrian. In the background, city buildings are visible as is a large antenna.

A bright city scene of cars driving down the road toward and away from an intersection. On the far side, an orange sign sits on the sidewalk with a pedestrian visible in the distance by a parking lot. In the background, tall buildings are visible.

A dark grey sky covers the intersection of Clinton and Roosevelt at which cars wait. Other cars are visible further down the road as are buildings in the background with lights on. At the intersection is an illuminated billboard over a grey building.

An urban scene with a blue, grey sky covers the intersection of Clinton and Roosevelt at which a car sits while other cars drive on the intersecting roads. At the intersection a billboard is illuminated over a grey building behind which the skyline is visible with an antenna and buildings with lights on.

Cars wait on one side of the intersection of Roosevelt and Clinton while other cars drive through. Pedestrians walk on the sidewalk and a scooter is in the bike lane. The sky has a layer of thin clouds under which we can see a parking lot with cars and buildings of the city sky line and antenna behind them. A billboard is at the intersection over a grey building.

An urban night scene in which multiple cars drive in opposite directions while some are parked near. An illuminated area is next to the road, showing an orange sign, which is near another business parking lot. In the background a city skyline is visible under a dark sky.
A dark, urban scene in which a car drives on the road past businesses and their illuminated parking lots. On the other side of the road an orange sign sits on the sidewalk under the dark sky.

A hazy night scene at the intersection of Canal and Roosevelt with cars that can be seen driving in the distance. A the corner is a parking lot with a few cars and multi-modal transport containers. In the background buildings can be seen through the haze.

An overcast sky covers a street on which cars and a bus drive by a line of businesses and pedestrians walking on the sidewalk. Nearby is a parking lot with cars parked. In the background, a billboard, antenna, and tall building are visible.

A dark, grey sky of clouds covers a street with cars driving on it and a truck with a trailer parked near a parking lot and line of businesses. A billboard, antenna, and tall building are visible in the background.

The sky is overcast covering a road with cars visible in the background driving. One side of the street is lined with businesses and a pedestrian on the sidewalk walking towards a parking lot with cars. Another pedestrian crosses the street. A billboard, tall buildings, and an antenna are visible in the background.

An overcast sky covers a city street with many cars driving down a road lined with businesses. To the right is a parking lot with cars parked and in the distance there is a billboard, antenna, and tall building visible.

A clear, blue sky over a city street on which many cars and a bus drive by a line of businesses. People walk in a parking lot to the right with cars parked there. Snow is visible on the ground and a billboard, antenna, and tall buildings are seen in the background.

A hazy, wet night over a city street on which cars drive by a line of businesses and parking lot with cars parked in it. In the background, an illuminated billboard, antenna, and tall building are visible.

A grey, night sky over a city street in which cars are driving in opposite directions. Next to the road is a line of businesses with a parking lot and cars parked. In the background a billboard is illuminated and also sits an antenna and tall building.

To the left are trains on train tracks sitting under an empty overpass with construction signs. On the right, trains with red lights can be seen on more tracks while in the background the skyline of city buildings can be seen under a cloudy sky.
An overcast sky covers a busy road over which passes traffic. On its sides, pedestrians walk on the sidewalk and to either side of the image are parking lots with cars and businesses.

Trains and train tracks are to the left and under an overpass on which cars drive and pedestrians walk. To the right are more trains and tracks while in the background the skyline of city buildings sits under a blue, grey sky.

An overcast sky covers the sun over a city street where cars drive and are stopped at intersections. Sidewalks are on either side of the streets with pedestrians visible and businesses lining the sides along with their respective parking lots with cars.

To the left trains sit on tracks and under an overpass on which drive cars and pedestrians walk. Construction signs are visible on the overpass. to the right are more trains and tracks. In the background, the skyline of tall buildings sits under a blue and cloudy sky.

To the left, a train and tracks are visible under and overpass with heavy traffic. To the right are more trains and tracks. In the background the skyline of city buildings is visible under the blue sky with occasional clouds.

Trains and tracks are visible with snow nearby under an overpass with a pedestrian, cars, and a bus driving on it. To the right, more trains are situated and in the background the sky line is comprised of a sunset over a series of tall buildings.

To the left trains sit on tracks under and overpass on which many cars drive and pedestrians walk about. Construction signs are visible. To the right more trains and train tracks sit. In the background, the city skyline is comprised of tall buildings under a grey sky.
A grey, hazy night sky covers a city street on which cars drive and a bus waits. On either side, businesses line the snow covered sidewalks and beyond those are parking lots with a few cars.

To the left a bike share sits to the side of the road with cars driving on the other side. Further along is a snowy area with train tracks. In the background, the city skyline is visible as many tall buildings with lights on and grey clouds covering most of the sky.

To the left is a bike share in front of a road with cars driving away. On the other side of the road is an empty area with train tracks behind which a series of brown buildings and trees sit between it and a skyline of buildings with lights on under a mostly grey, cloudy sky.

To the left is a bike share next to a road on which few cars are visible. To the right is a dark area with train tracks and in the background the skyline of city buildings with lights on is visible under a dark, blue sky.

To the left is a bike share on the side of an empty road on whose other side sits a dark, empty area with train tracks. In the background, there is a series of brown buildings and trees in front of the city skyline of tall buildings with lights on under a night's blue, grey sky.

To the left is a bike share next to a road on whose other side is a dark empty area with train tracks. A car can be seen in the distance driving towards the sky line behind a series of brown buildings under the blue, grey night sky.

Pedestrians cross a crosswalk and walk on the sidewalks while cars drive. The entrance and exit to an enclave of buildings is shouldered by decorative bulbs and bushes and in the middle sits a sign. While on other side of the roads sit businesses and residences above them, in the middle is a parking entrance with a decorative structure. In the background tall buildings are visible under a cloudy sky.

To the left train tracks go under and overpass with graffiti on it. Above, cars drive in the distance over the wet road alongside which buildings line the sidewalks. There is condensation on the lens.
A grey, hazy sky covers the sky skyline of buildings with lights on in front of which bare trees and brown buildings sit. Next to them is a road on which cars drive by an area with train tracks.

A blue sky with some thin clouds sits over a street on which a bus and cars can be seen driving. A bike is on the side of the road and a pedestrian is crossing the street toward an empty area with train tracks. On the other side of the road is a series of brown buildings and bare trees behind which sits the skyline of city buildings.

A hazy, overcast sky covers a road on which cars can be seen driving in the distance. On the right is an empty area with train tracks. To the left is a series of brown buildings with bare trees before the skyline of city buildings.

Traffic and a biker wait at an intersection while other cars drive through. An orange sign sits on the sidewalk near which a pedestrian waits. In the background, the city sky line of buildings with lights on is visible under a dark blue sky.

Many cars wait at an intersection along with a bus while a car turns near a pedestrian. On the other side of the intersection is an orange sign on the sidewalk while behind it sits a series of bare trees and brown buildings. In the background, under the sparse clouds in the blue sky, sit the sky line of many tall buildings.

A raised intersection at which sit two cars. On the other side is an orange sign behind which is a series of brown buildings and trees. In the background, the city skyline is comprised of tall buildings with lights on and a mostly grey, cloudy sky.

Traffic drive through an intersection while another car waits. An orange sign sits on the sidewalk near which a pedestrian waits. In the background, the city sky line of buildings with lights on is visible behind an area with trees and brown buildings under a dark blue sky.

A bright, blue sky with few clouds sits over an intersection at which cars wait near an orange sign. Pedestrians walk along the sidewalk on both sides of the street. Brown buildings and bare trees sit between the street and skyline comprised of tall buildings.

Cars drive through and intersection on a rainy day while a pedestrian walks on the sidewalk. On the other side of the road is a series of brown buildings with bare trees and behind them the city skyline can be seen comprised of tall buildings under a grey sky.
Cars drive down a road near a business and pedestrian. To the right, a path goes through a park area with bare trees and in the background tall city buildings sit under a cloudy sky.

A raise intersection on which cars drive. Snow is visible and on the other side of the intersection is an orange sign behind which is a series of brown buildings and bare trees. In the background the sky line is filled with buildings under a dark blue sky and a moon.

Pedestrians and a dog cross the intersection of Roosevelt and State while pedestrians wait nearby to cross the road. Cars wait at the intersection while other cars are visible down the road and others parked in a nearby lot under a raised train platform behind which sit a series of tall city buildings. In the foreground is an orange bike detour sign.

A snowy, urban scene in which many buildings are behind a raised, train platform which sits over a parking lot with cars. A pedestrian nearby walks by the intersection of State and Roosevelt while cars wait on the road. In the foreground, an orange bike detour sign is on the sidewalk with footprints in the snow.
A car is at an intersection on a wet road during a hazy night. One side has litter visible while the other has an empty sidewalk separated from a building and trees by a fence.

A dark, urban scene in which cars can be seen on a road in the distance at night. Sparse snow lines the sidewalks on either side and on the far side a fence separates the sidewalk from bare trees and a series of buildings.

A dark, urban scene in which snow is on the side of a street which has cars waiting at an intersection and driving closer. On the other side, pedestrians walk along a fence which separates them from bare trees and a line of buildings.
A dark, urban scene of an empty road at night. Sparse snow lines the sidewalks on either side and on the far side a fence separates the sidewalk from bare trees and a series of buildings.

A dark, urban scene in which buildings sit behind a raised, illuminated train platform under which cars are parked in a lot. At the intersection nearby, cars are seen driving away and an orange bike detour sign is visible on the sidewalk.

A dark, urban scene in which many buildings with lights on are behind a raised, illuminated train platform which sits over a parking lot with cars. A pedestrian nearby walks by the intersection of State and Roosevelt while cars drive on the road. In the foreground, an orange bike detour sign is on the sidewalk.

A grey, blue sky covers a city street intersection at which wait many cars. On the other side, a pedestrian waits at a bus stop while others walk along a fence separating them from bare trees and buildings.

Many tall buildings with lights on sit behind a raised, illuminated train station under which cars are parked in a parking lot. Nearby is the intersection of State and Roosevelt at which a car waits. On the sidewalk is an orange bike detour sign and snow is visible on the ground.

A night image in which buildings with lights on sit in the background behind an illuminated train station. Under the train station cars drive by and are parked in an illuminated lot. At the intersection, a bus and cars wait as more cars approach. In the foreground, an orange bike detour sign sits on the sidewalk next to a bare tree.

Cars wait on one side of the intersection of State and Roosevelt while a pedestrian stands nearby. Other cars drive on the perpendicular road past the bare trees and brown building. Buildings are visible in the background in the clear, blue sky.

Pedestrians walk on the left sidewalk and cross the road while many cars wait at an intersection. On the other side, a bus is stopped under a raised train platform on which people wait. Behind the platform, buildings are in the sun while on the other side of the road snow and bare trees are visible.

A truck, cars, and bus wait at the intersection of State and Roosevelt where a person waits at a bus stop. Another pedestrian can be seen walking on the sidewalk by bare trees and a brown building under the clear, blue sky.

A snowy day in the city during which many cars can be seen waiting for pedestrians to cross the crosswalk. Pedestrians can also be seen walking about the wet sidewalks and waiting on a raised train platform behind which tall buildings sit in a bright, white sky.

Pedestrians walk down the left sidewalk where a bus stops next to a traffic waiting at an intersection. Overhead is a train station with people waiting on it. Behind the train station is a series of a buildings in the clear, blue sky. On the other side of the road, bare trees visible and more people walk on the sidewalks.

A blue sky with sparse, wispy clouds over the skyline of tall buildings that sit behind a raised train platform with a train stopped there. Cars drive on the road underneath and pedestrians walk about on the sidewalk and crossing the crosswalk.

Pedestrians wait at the intersection of State and Roosevelt while others wait at a nearby bus stop., More pedestrians walk about near a descending staircase under the blue sky. Cars can be seen driving on the road to the left and parked on the side by a building with bare trees near.

A city street on which cars drive on a divided road on which a dissembled barricade sits. Pedestrians walk on the other side of the wet road and another waits near traffic cones at the intersection behind which sits a series of buildings under the blue and cloudy sky.
A dark, urban scene in which a car waits at the intersection of Roosevelt. City buildings line the sidewalks and a bike can be seen nearby.

A dark, urban scene in which cars drive on both sides of the road and a dissembled barricade sits on the divider between them. On the other side, a bike is parked in front of a building and a person waits nearby. In the distance, cars are visible and buildings under a night sky.

Pedestrians wait at an intersection while others walk along with a dog. Many cars wait at the intersection while one turns right. The sky is blue and sunny over buildings which sit near a nearly empty parking lot.

An urban scene in which snow is on either side of a wet road with that is divided in two with a dissembled barricade on the divider. Cars can be seen in the distance at an intersection. On the other side of the road is a line of buildings illuminated with street lamps.
Many cars wait at the intersection of Roosevelt while pedestrians cross the crosswalk. One one side of the road buildings line the sidewalks while on the other trees run parallel on a grassy area.

A dark sky with clouds over a a city street with cars going in both directions through an intersection. One side is lined with tall buildings while the other is lined with trees running parallel on a grassy area near a bus stop. A pedestrian is visible walking on the sidewalk near the buildings.

Pedestrians wait on the sidewalk next to a disassembled barricade and a car waits at stoplight at the intersection of Roosevelt Rd. One one side, trees are line a grassy area running parallel to street lamps. On the other, many tall buildings line the road with trees near that are strung with decorative lights. Water is on the ground suggesting rain and the sky is overcast.

A dusk sky over tall buildings that line a city street lit with street lamps. Running parallel on the opposite side are a line of trees over a snow. A pedestrian can be seen at the intersection, at the bus stop, and walking on the sidewalks while cars are driving on the road.
Cars drive on a divided, wet road with dirty snow seen on either side. On the other side, buildings line the sidewalk and cars can be seen in the distance.
An ultra-wide image of an urban landscape in which buildings and city lights are visible in between trees. A plume of pollution is seen in the background.
An ultra-wide view of an urban skyline in which sparse clouds are visible and the lights of buildings.

Two roads with cars on them converge at an intersection next to a gas station. Residential buildings line the road with cars parked in lots adjacent to them. In the center, a playground sits between a mix of evergreen and bare trees and more residential buildings with parking lots with cars.
An ultra-wide view of a blue, cloudy sky over an urban landscape in which green trees and buildings are visible.
